title: Choose the visual world for SmartHerd
question: Formal and minimalist, for a cooperative weighing goats in daylight. Keep the lead direction, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Banig Ledger
options.lineage: Philippine woven banig mats, pandan and buri with dyed bands
options.thesis: A quiet straw-and-ink record where each goat's growth is woven as one dyed band.
options.viewport: Top bar 'SmartHerd' with sync state; one large New weighing button; below, your herd as rows each ending in a short woven growth band.
options.risk: The weave must stay a data band; drawn as decoration it turns into craft-fair ornament.

raised.raise: Colour is quarantined: the dyed green lives only in the growth band, the primary action and selection; everything else is ink on straw.
The weighing flow shows one decision per screen in sentence case, the next step set large.
Neutrals are snapped to one fixed tonal ramp; no ad-hoc greys.
Goat rows show name, weight and band only; measurements open on tap.

options.label: Extension Bulletin
options.lineage: DA / PCAARRD livestock technical bulletins with measured animal diagrams
options.thesis: The result screen as a printed technical plate: a goat outline with its four measurements drawn on it.
options.viewport: Result screen: Estimated Weight large, a side-and-top goat diagram with dimension lines for length, height, width and girth.
options.risk: The most familiar route for a measurement app; can read like a textbook figure.

options.label: Weigh Slip & Sale Board
options.thesis: Each weighing is a segmented slip; the herd is a board ranked by days to sale weight.
options.viewport: Home is a board: goats ranked by closeness to sale weight, a newly ready goat lit amber until seen.
options.case: Strong on clarity (ranking toward sale weight is the co-op's real question); weaker on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads like a travel app if the slip segments get decorative.

options.label: Lexicon Plate
options.thesis: Black text columns with colour only inside bordered plates.
options.viewport: Goat entries set as dictionary columns.
options.risk: Foreign to the audience and dense for outdoor use.
options.case: Loses both axes for farmers in the pen.
options.kept: Colour quarantine: colour only where it carries data.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: One message per band, the next decision monumental.
options.viewport: Capture flow as overhead sign bands.
options.risk: Loud yellow fights the formal brief.
options.case: Loses both axes; too loud for formal.
options.kept: One decision per screen in the weighing flow.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Tones snapped to an eleven-step zone ramp.
options.risk: Hatch language is unreadable for this audience.
options.kept: A fixed tonal ramp as the only neutrals.

options.label: Title Card Wall
options.thesis: Rows of tiles that expand on focus.
options.risk: Entertainment register, no goat photos to carry it.
options.kept: Detail revealed only on focus; rows stay sparse.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: One reserved colour for the active course over a fixed terrain language.
options.viewport: Herd as terrain, weighing as course.
options.case: Loses both axes; its reserved-colour discipline is already carried by the colour quarantine.
options.kept: A single reserved colour for the active item.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean Material 3 livestock app: white surfaces, green primary, cards and a FAB.
canonCard.viewport: Herd list in cards, green FAB for New weighing, bottom nav.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any farm app template.
